scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "pnpm --filter bill-splitter-api dev" "pnpm --filter bill-splitter-web dev"
scripts.test: pnpm --filter bill-splitter-api test && pnpm --filter bill-splitter-web test
scripts.migrate:remote: pnpm --filter bill-splitter-api exec wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote
scripts.deploy:web: pnpm --filter bill-splitter-web build && pnpm --filter bill-splitter-api exec wrangler pages deploy ../web/dist --project-name bill-splitter-web
